full_prompt_en: A square anime-style ensemble illustration presents six fantasy characters in overlapping upper-body portraits against a split ochre and teal background. A thin pale border frames the group. At the front center, a youthful figure with tousled golden hair and large green eyes looks directly outward. A white shirt with a ruffled collar sits beneath a green vest laced at the chest, making the central torso the brightest clothing area. On the front right, a pale-haired young figure in white with an orange bow looks to the side with wide turquoise eyes. At the lower left, a brown-haired young woman turns left in profile, her dark outer clothing merging gently with the warm background. Behind the central figure, a red-haired person in dark high-collared clothing faces forward, giving the arrangement a raised central peak. On the upper left, an older stern figure with spiky silver hair turns outward in side view, the face modeled with stronger lines and warm shadow. On the upper right, another pale-haired figure faces right, wearing a brown high collar. The heads form a loose pyramid, with each profile alternating direction and the central direct gaze holding the group together. The background switches from golden orange on the left to green-blue on the right; its texture is softly mottled rather than a detailed place. Clean dark linework defines hair spikes, eyes, noses, and costume seams, while translucent painted shading warms cheeks and folds. Light appears broad and even from the front, with small highlights in the eyes and hair but few hard cast shadows. The overall composition is energetic and balanced, using varied hair silhouettes, saturated opposing background colors, and tightly layered faces to suggest a connected cast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画风格群像插画让六名奇幻人物以上半身肖像层叠排列，背景分为赭金与青绿色两块。细浅色边框围住这一组人。前景中央，一名金色乱发、绿眼的大眼睛青年正面望出。白衬衫的荷叶领位于胸前系带的绿马甲之下，使中央上身成为最亮的衣着区域。右前方，一名浅发年轻人物穿白衣、系橙色蝴蝶结，以睁大的青绿眼睛向侧方看。左下，一名棕发年轻女子向左侧转身，深色外衣柔和地融入暖色背景。中央人物后方，一名红发者穿深色高领衣服正面朝前，为人群形成升高的中央顶点。左上，一名银发尖刺状、神情严肃的年长人物以侧面朝外，面部由更强的线条和暖影塑形。右上，另一名浅发人物面向右侧，穿棕色高领。头部组成松散金字塔，各个侧面交替指向不同方向，中央直视将整组凝聚。背景从左侧金橙转为右侧青绿，表面柔和斑驳，而非具体地点。清晰深色线条界定发束、眼睛、鼻梁和服装接缝，半透明绘画阴影温暖面颊与衣褶。光似乎从前方宽广均匀地照来，眼睛和头发有小高光，却少有坚硬投影。整体构图有能量且均衡，以不同发型剪影、背景中对置的饱和颜色和紧密叠起的面孔暗示一组相连的人物。
style_prompt_en: The anime illustration uses clean expressive linework around enlarged eyes, sharp hair shapes, and layered costume contours. Warm ochre and cool teal divide the background into broad opposing fields, while varied saturated accents keep overlapping forms distinct. Faces are softly modeled with translucent color and small highlights, but most depth comes from stacking silhouettes in shallow layers. Different head heights and alternating directions create a loose pyramidal rhythm around a stronger central focal point. Fine hair strands and seams add detail only where the eye needs it; the background stays softly mottled and nonliteral. Broad frontal illumination preserves readable expression without heavy cast shadows. A light framing margin contains the energetic grouping. The overall effect is bright, characterful, and cohesive, balancing precise graphic contours with warm painted shading.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动画插画以清晰而富表情的线条围住放大的眼睛、尖锐发束和层叠衣装轮廓。暖赭与冷青绿把背景分成宽阔对置色域，多种饱和重音让互相遮挡的形体清楚区分。面部由半透明颜色和小高光柔和塑形，但大部分纵深来自剪影的浅层叠放。不同高度和交替朝向形成围绕较强中央焦点的松散金字塔节奏。细发丝与接缝只在视线需要处增加细节，背景保持柔和斑驳而不指向具体场景。宽广正面照明让表情易读，无须厚重投影。一道浅亮边框容纳活跃的组合。整体效果明亮、富角色感且统一，在精确图形轮廓与温暖绘画阴影之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A colorful ensemble of anime fantasy characters arranged in layered portraits
theme_zh: 一组奇幻动画人物以层叠肖像形式排列
name: Nanatsu no Taizai
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
